elements.evidence: "governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York"

elements.element: Exclusive jurisdiction is conferred (not merely non-exclusive/permissive)

offending_extra_words: will be subject to and resolved exclusively by the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York
reasons: Preferred level is complete: New York governing law plus exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, a permitted corresponding pair.
Fallback is not satisfied on its own terms (no Delaware/California/England and Wales law or forum), but that is irrelevant because the locked preferred level is met.

Minimality fails: the second operation rewrites the dispute-resolution mechanic and repeats the venue grant already inserted in operation 1; the official minimality gate flags both operations (word ratio 2.00 and changed-character ratio 0.897).

Intent is not preserved: with arbitration deleted, the surviving sentence "Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment" is a dangling mechanic referring to an arbitrator that the Agreement no longer appoints.

Tighter approach: replace only "the Arizona" with "the State of New York" and append a short exclusive-venue sentence; if arbitration must go, also delete or conform the arbitrator-award confirmation sentence.
